    volume_hidden == 0 AND
    media_type == 3 AND
    (Archos_smbserver == 0 OR
    Archos_smbserver IN (SELECT _id FROM smb_server WHERE active == 1))

                  group_concat( episode_id ) AS episode_ids, group_concat( video_id ) AS video_ids,
